landing.heroSubtitle: Flash Learn turns anything you want to learn into flashcards and schedules each review for the moment just before you’d forget so it sticks with minutes a day, not hours of cramming.
landing.demoFront: How do you say “to remember” in Spanish?
landing.featuresTitle: A focused toolkit for durable memory
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything here exists for one reason: to move what you learn into long-term memory, and keep you coming back.
landing.feat1Body: An adaptive SM-2 schedule brings each card back right before you’d forget it the proven path to long-term recall.
landing.feat2Body: Browse public decks from other learners and clone any of them in a click, or keep your own decks private.
landing.feat3Body: Daily streaks, XP and a leaderboard keep your momentum visible motivation without the busywork.
landing.feat4Body: Review only what’s due in short, deliberate sessions. Rate each card and the schedule adapts on its own.
landing.feat5Body: Your decks and progress stay yours. Private by default, with no ads and no invasive tracking.
landing.feat6Body: Install it on desktop or phone and review online or off. Everything syncs the moment you reconnect.
landing.howTitle: Three steps, then let it run
landing.howSubtitle: A simple loop built to stay consistent long after the motivation fades.
landing.step1Body: Write your own cards, draft a deck with AI, or clone one from the community in seconds.
landing.step2Body: Each day Flash Learn shows only the cards due that day. Rate how well you recalled each one.
landing.step3Body: Reviews space out as memories strengthen. Track your streak, stats and what’s coming next.
landing.aiTitle: Turn any topic into a deck in seconds
landing.aiSubtitle: Describe what you want to learn and AI drafts the first set of flashcards for you. You review and edit every card before anything is saved AI writes the draft, you stay in control.
landing.aiPoint1Body: Give it a subject, language and difficulty. Get a clean first draft in seconds instead of typing dozens of cards by hand.
landing.aiPoint2Body: Edit, rewrite or remove any card in the preview. Nothing reaches your deck until you say so.
landing.aiPoint3Body: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible key. It’s stored only in your browser and sent straight to your provider never to us.
landing.aiNote: To be clear: AI only helps you build decks faster. The reviewing and memorization run on the spaced-repetition algorithm not on guesswork.
landing.useCasesTitle: Built for how people actually study
landing.useCasesSubtitle: However you learn best, the loop is the same: small daily reviews that compound over time.
landing.useCase1Body: Vocabulary, phrases and grammar with audio and rich text on every card.
landing.useCase2Body: High-volume facts, drugs and pathways that have to stay reliable under pressure.
landing.useCase3Body: Civil-service exams, entrance tests and licensing, reviewed steadily over months.
landing.useCase4Body: APIs, shortcuts and definitions you want at your fingertips, not buried in a tab.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Build a memory you can rely on
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Create a free account and start your first review in under a minute.
